title: Published Envelope Dataset Manifest
description: Metadata-only layer describing one Package / Dataset. Contract from MANIFEST_SSOT. Manifest ≠ Dataset ≠ Strategy. No EnvelopeRecord payload, Modal, Geometry, Index, Search Result.

packageReference.description: Reference to the corresponding Package Identity (does not embed Package payload).

datasetReference.description: Reference to the corresponding Dataset Identity (does not embed EnvelopeRecord[]).

versionReference.description: Optional Version Reference placeholder. Version format out of scope.

createdAt.description: Optional logical creation time metadata. Concrete datetime format out of scope.

generatorBuildMetadata.description: Optional Generator Build Metadata bag. Must not contain Strategy/Modal/EnvelopeRecord.
